subject: Novus: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA, auth logs, access reviews)
messages:
From: Claire Dempsey <claire.dempsey@novushealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@novushealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + targeted artifacts for procurement review

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well — we’re running a procurement security review for Novus Health and need your SOC 2 Type II report and several supporting artifacts to close our security gate. Specifically we’d like: 

- Your latest SOC 2 Type II report (period and auditor name)
- A bridge letter if the report period doesn’t fully cover our contract window
- MFA evidence: push/OTP acceptance logs, and a short explanation of how Redwood validates device-based MFA (Okta/IdP details welcome)
- Authn log slices for the audit window: we typically request a 48-hour slice showing: timestamp, user id, auth method, success/failure, IP, and SAML assertion id (if applicable)
- Access review artifacts for privileged accounts (attestation records, reviewer names, dates)

We need these items by 2028-03-18 to hit our vendor approval timeline. If any of this requires an NDA or an alternate upload method (SFTP/secure Drive), let me know.

Also: we’re primarily focused on the period 2027-09-01 through 2028-02-28 — if your SOC 2 coverage is different, please indicate the audit window and whether a bridge letter is available.

Thanks,
Claire Dempsey
Sr. Security Program Manager, Novus Health
claire.dempsey@novushealth.com
security: 415-555-0112

Attachment: novus_vendor_q1_security_questions_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dempsey <claire.dempsey@novushealth.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted artifacts for procurement review

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide the SOC 2 Type II and targeted artifact slices; below is what we’ll deliver and a couple clarifying questions so we scope exactly what you need.

Planned deliverables (initial package by 2028-03-17):
- Redwood_Soc2_TypeII_2027_summary.pdf (report summary and auditor statement)
- Bridge letter covering 2028-02-28 (if our audit window ends before your required dates)
- MFA slice: Okta authentication events (push/OTP) for a 48-hour window — fields: timestamp, user_id (pseudonymized on request), auth_method, result, ip_address, device_id (if available)
- Authn log slice: 48-hour export showing SAML assertion ids, session creation, refresh token events, and error codes
- Privileged account attestation CSV: account_id, role, last_review_date, reviewer, outcome
- Short writeup describing MFA enforcement (policy/exception process) and retention period for logs

Clarifying questions:
1) For the authn log slice, do you require raw SAML assertion payloads, or will assertion ids + timestamp suffice? We’re cautious about sharing full assertion payloads without an MoU.
2) Do you prefer pseudonymized user IDs (prefix-redacted) for the exports, or full emails? Many customers ask for pseudonymization for HIPAA contexts.
3) Upload method: we can share via a time-limited Google Drive link or a secure SFTP dropbox. Which works for Novus?

Cc’ing Olga (security/compliance) and Grace (Customer Success) to help coordinate the attestation CSV and bridge letter. Olga — can you confirm approximate earliest we can redact PII and produce the authn slice?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

Attachment: requested_artifact_manifest.csv (csv)

From: Claire Dempsey <claire.dempsey@novushealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@novushealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted artifacts for procurement review

Thanks Karthik — this looks good. A couple of quick clarifications from our side: 

- Assertion IDs + timestamp will be sufficient (no need for full SAML payloads)
- We prefer pseudonymized user IDs for any artifacts that could include PHI
- Upload: secure Drive link is fine, but we will need a short statement that the export was generated by Redwood and unchanged (hash or manifest OK)

Priority order (if you need to phase delivery): 1) Bridge letter + SOC2 PDF, 2) MFA slice, 3) Authn slice, 4) Privileged attestation CSV + writeup

One more ask: for the MFA slice, could you include a short sample (5–10 lines) showing both push successes and push failures with IPs and device_id? That helps our ops team validate correlation rules.

If you can get the SOC2 + bridge letter to us by 2028-03-15 and the MFA slice by 2028-03-17, we should be OK for internal review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to sign an MoU if your security team needs it.

Claire

Claire — quick update and delivery plan: 

- SOC2 Type II summary (PDF) and a formal bridge letter for the period ending 2028-02-28: will be uploaded to a time-limited Drive folder by 2028-03-15. (Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_2027_summary.pdf, redwood_bridge_letter_2027-02-28.pdf)
- MFA 48-hour slice: target upload 2028-03-17. We will provide a 5–10 line sample inline in the Drive folder and the full CSV with pseudonymized user_ids as requested.
- Authn log slice: target upload 2028-03-19 (we need to run a small redaction process to remove PII from assertion metadata).
- Privileged account attestation CSV and short writeup: target upload 2028-03-18.

Olga — we’ll need the attestation CSV and a sign-off on the bridge letter by 2028-03-13 to meet the SOC2 upload timeline. Can you confirm?

Claire — once we prepare the Drive folder I’ll send you the link and a manifest file (sha256 hashes) for the main artifacts. If Novus prefers SFTP, we can accommodate — just advise.

Thanks again for the clear priorities. We’ll keep communication tight over the next week and flag anything that would impact the dates above.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering
